scope: First ground/coherent10 fixed-potential 4s/4p valence CI only; no LS/rates/lifetime
method: Restore paired ground_coherent10 potential; same disabled Breit/SE/VP/MS/config-corrections and orbital controls; reproduce radial preflight before Structure, export full mode0 native basis/coefficient text and complete mode10 binary C/CM. No fresh SCF.
guards: All preflight bound/overlap/physical-orbital guards before CI; exact old/new orbital metadata and physical samples after CI; source-mapped potential protection; full 8-electron/J/parity/ID/config inventory and actual zero corrections; streaming signed native/binary coefficient equality including nonzero-omission rejection.
resource_policy: One native case, single thread, nice19; retain /usr/bin/time -v actual RSS/wall time. Check available RAM/disk before remaining cases; no parallel solver.
failure_policy: Stop and preserve every failure; no changed criterion or retry without new declaration
